overview: A heavy AI-model day: Thinking Machines shipped Inkling 2 Mini, a 26B model that runs on a laptop. Google recapped its Gemini 4 lineup, and OpenAI posted robotics and drug-discovery gains. On markets, burrytracker reports Burry trimmed his Nvidia and semiconductor puts, while the All-In crew covered Anthropic going public and the turmoil at Nvidia.

top_items.title: Mira Murati - Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Mini is a 26B looped transformer that runs on a laptop and scores 20.1 on AA Index
GoogleAI - Gemini 4 Neon, Hydrogen and Carbon launched alongside Genie 4, Gemini Robotics 2.5 and AlphaGenome 2
burrytracker - Burry reportedly sold 50% of his NVDA and SMH puts, kept Nasdaq 100 April 2027 puts, and added 20% to MELI
Chamath Palihapitiya - New All-In episode covers Anthropic going public, Nvidia's stock slide and talent crisis, and whether the market has bottomed
Chamath Palihapitiya - Social Capital says ~79% of Anthropic's 2026 revenue is usage-based and new-model discounts cut ~$600M from Q3
Greg Brockman - Partner xdof says GPT-6.2 Astra scored 41.2% on its Ember-0 robotics benchmark, up from 19.6% for GPT-6 Astra in September
Demis Hassabis - Isomorphic Labs signs a research deal with Merck (MSD) that Hassabis says includes designing a new cancer drug
Greg Brockman - OpenAI launches MedChemBench, a medicinal-chemistry benchmark Brockman says shows very strong model progress
